title: Poly Effects Beebo

x_pc.additionalInfo: PC numbers match set-list slot numbers on the preset screen. No fixed factory CC map — MIDI learn per control (hold more / triple-dots, press slider, then MIDI icon).

additionalInfo: Hector/Beebo/Digit manual. Before Beebo serial 338: Type B TRS In. Serial 338+: Type A In / Type B Out. MIDI clock sync without patch routing. Notes and CCs also bind via learn (e.g. Loopler).
